Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Join target_dictionary to assays on tid, assays to activities on assay_id, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (inner join). Filter target to chembl_id 'CHEMBL1817', target_type 'SINGLE PROTEIN', organism 'Homo sapiens'. Filter activities to standard_type 'IC50', standard_relation '=', pchembl_value not null. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000 rows.
